Love this app! || Favorite habit tracker hands down. I love the simple design, customizable colors, and the choice between dark and light mode for the widget. Light Icon Gone || I enjoyed the previous version because it gave me the option to customize the color of my icon. I’m not sure why the developers took that setting away. Why low contrast? || I like the design of this app and wanted to subscribe except for one problem. There is very low contrast between the font and the background on the habit tracking screen. I tried multiple colors and themes and they are all low contrast. Not accessible for anyone who needs high contrast. I can see it but it makes my brain work harder than it should. UPDATE: I was able to correct this problem after receiving feedback from the developer. I had to make sure that I had selected days that my activity was activated. After I did this, the contrast was normal.

Textsize of Goals... || The app font size of each individual goal's title should be smaller overall, or there should be a single-line title with a multi-line description underneath.
